subject: Insurance
title: COVID-19: The Pandemic Exclusion
description: A fast breakdown of COVID-19: The Pandemic Exclusion for builders.

hook.text: COVID-19 caused trillions in economic losses. But most business insurance policies excluded pandemics.

buildup.text: Businesses bought 'business interruption' insurance expecting it to cover shutdowns.

discovery.text: Courts mostly sided with insurers. The policies clearly excluded viruses and pandemics.

twist.text: Insurers paid $44 billion in COVID-related claims globally—mostly life and health.

climax.text: COVID exposed the biggest gap in modern insurance.

punchline.text: Trillions in losses, most claims denied.

quiz.question: Why were most COVID business interruption claims denied?
options: Policies excluded pandemics and required physical damage
